youtube_description:
Mark Morton will be releasing his first solo album "Anesthetic" on March 1st 2019. #UltimateGuitar recently had a chance to catch up with #MarkMorton to discuss the record (including a track featuring vocals from the late #ChesterBennington). You can check out the full conversation here: https://www.ultimate-guitar.com/news/interviews/lamb_of_gods_mark_morton_discusses_new_solo_album_reveals_his_definition_of_a_successful_guitarist.html
